<subject>Meridian?</subject>

Antony,

Harrison Partners, on behalf of the Litigation Division, will be issuing tenders for external counsel services. We are currently considering limited engagements, and would like to finalise an NDA. We would like to quickly follow up regarding the status of the NDA agreement between yourselves and the Litigation Division. If your legal team has any questions or concerns, please contact Dale Fletcher of Harrison Partners at +44 7817 646361.

To address any compliance concerns you may have, the division is currently preparing a full compliance dossier which we will share with you upon completion.

Again, please do not hesitate to call.

Thank You,  
Rachael Lewis  
Coordinator
